paper_title: Search for ultralight axion dark matter in a side-band analysis of a 199Hg free-spin precession signal
notes: Search for axion-wind spin precession modulation of 199Hg FSP signal at PSI. Limit on axion-nucleon coupling g_aNN quoted in GeV^-1 (derivative coupling convention), NOT dimensionless g_an. Mass range 1e-16 to ~1.4e-13 eV (fa up to ~34 Hz). Peak sensitivity g_aNN ~= 3.5e-6 GeV^-1. Exclusion is a varying curve in Fig.4 with dips at multiples of fHg=7.879 Hz and around 4 Hz; only the peak value and mass range are available from text, so data_points are approximate horizontal placeholders at peak sensitivity.
